title: Youth Romantic Comedy is Wrong, as I Expected
overview: Hachiman Hikigaya is a loner with an inferiority complex who is tricked into joining the "Service Club" that helps students with their problems… at all costs.

title: All People Surely Have Their Own Worries
overview: Hachiman bears witness as Yui tries to either fit in or break away from her social group. Later, the club receives a new request from an old friend of Hachiman’s.

title: Sometimes the Gods of Rom-Coms Does Nice Things
overview: As Hachiman continues to hone his skills in the art of being left alone, another student comes to him with a new request for the club.

title: In Other Words, He Doesn’t Have Many Friends
overview: Hachiman has a small crisis concerning little sisters and what they mean.  Afterward he receives a mysterious text, outlining the club’s next student request.

title: Once Again, He Turns Back on the Path from Whence He Came
overview: Hachiman’s sister is asks for advice from her classmates.  Apparently she has been acting strange lately, and the Service Club intends to find out why.

title: His Beginning With Her Finally Ends
overview: Shizuka announces that Hachiman and Yui must go on a recruitment drive to find more members, and they know exactly who to target.

title: Anyway, Getting No Rest, Even Though it’s Summer Break, Just Isn’t Right
overview: Hachiman tries his best to relax during Summer break but constant texts from Shizuka concerning the Service Club activities prevent him from doing so.

title: One Day, They Will Learn the Truth
overview: Shizuka readies a bonfire and a "test of courage". Later, Yui recognizes the limo that hit Hachiman.

title: For the Third Time, He Turns Back on the Path from Whence He Came
overview: Yui invites Hachiman and Komachi to the annual summer fireworks festival. The pair run into Haruno, who explains the complicated relationship between herself and Yukino.

title: The Distance Between Them Remains Unchanged as the Festival is Becoming a Carnival
overview: Yui notices a rift forming between Hachiman and Yukino. Hachiman is nominated to serve on the committee for the school’s upcoming cultural festival.

title: And So the Curtain on Each Stage Rises, and the Festival is Festivaling Its Very Best
overview: Hachiman and Yui check on Yukino. Later, Hachiman shakes things up with the committee when he decides to alter their mindset.

title: Thus, His and Her and Her Youth Continues to Be Wrong
overview: Soubu High’s Cultural Festival continues and Hachiman is stuck carrying out his duty as a committee member by documenting the day’s events on film.

title: And So, Their Festival Will Never End
overview: A mysterious request to  helm the upcoming sports festival arrives. The group must band together to figure out a way to pull it off.
